title: Broken Mirror
description: Broken mirror, the broken mirror look, shards a person across cracked silver: one face that does not agree with itself, each shard a slightly different angle or time. Identity as a pile of cuts, and a crack overlay on a single face is not enough.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Breakdowns, vanity, a lie: bathroom or dressing-room practical, silver in the near plane, pieces of room in the glass. Argus is many eyes.
This is one face in pieces. A team photo does not want this.
It is the wrong tool when the shards do not hold different bits of the room, and the wrong tool if you wanted intact Reflections. Glass as a cut.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Lock off through the glass, 35mm to 50mm, bathroom practical. Cracked silver, multiple slices of the same person, shards as glass not as a kaleidoscope filter.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Broken Mirror in film?
Cracked silver as a split of identity: shards of one face that do not agree, each piece a slightly different angle or time. Not a crack sticker.
Broken Mirror vs Reflections
Reflections uses intact glass. Broken mirror uses shards that disagree. If the mirror is whole, you wanted reflections.
When should I use Broken Mirror?
Breakdowns, vanity, a lie. Skip team photos and overlay cracks.
How do I prompt Broken Mirror for AI image or video?
Bathroom practical, then: Broken-mirror of [Subject], silver shards, one face that does not agree with itself. Each shard must hold a different bit of room.
